column1: # V1c: OBS Studio over obs-websocket (obs-cmd through ~/.local/bin/obs-ctl). Format: see the header of ~/.config/hub/hub.
# One-time setup, only in OBS: Tools > WebSocket Server Settings > Enable WebSocket server (obs-ctl reads the port and
# password from OBS itself; nothing is stored in the repo). Rows hide when obs-cmd is not installed; every action says so
# in a notification when OBS is not running. Streaming is only in the OBS menu (and only when a stream key is configured).

column9: ON = OBS is recording. Needs OBS running with the WebSocket server enabled.
fzf-menu over `obs-cmd scene list`; the current scene is marked.

column3: Audio: toggle mute of an input (mic, desktop)
column9: fzf-menu over `obs-cmd input list`; Enter toggles the mute of that input.
column10: o m;Mute or unmute an input

column3: Replay buffer: save the last seconds
column9: Needs the replay buffer running (OBS > Start Replay Buffer).
One notification with the state of OBS.

column3: OBS menu (all actions, streaming when configured)
column9: fzf-menu with every OBS action; offers Start OBS when it is not running and Streaming only when a stream key is set in the OBS profile.
